name: run
motion: running in place with long, fast strides: knees come up, arms pump back and forth, both feet leave the ground in the middle of each stride, the body leans slightly forward

motion_by_dir.down: running in place toward the viewer: quick light steps, knees come up, arms bent at the elbows at the sides of the body, pumping forward and back; the hands never cross in front of the chest
motion_by_dir.up: running in place away from the viewer: quick light steps, knees come up, arms bent at the elbows at the sides of the body, pumping forward and back; the hands never cross in front of the chest
